This is McNeel's own openNURBS binding, published by them under MIT. Centina
uses it only for .3dm read and write, through the separate `io3dm.mjs` entry
point; nothing under `kernel/` touches it. No part of this project is derived
from any McNeel product beyond this library.


WHY THIS IS A LOCAL BUILD AND NOT AN NPM RELEASE
----------------------------------------------------------------
These files are built from rhino3dm's source rather than taken from a
published release, because no release exposes the Brep trim API (BrepLoop,
BrepTrim and the two list types) that READING a trimmed .3dm requires, nor any
Brep authoring at all, which WRITING one requires.

`rebuild.sh` in this directory reproduces the build from an upstream checkout.


WHAT brep_authoring.patch CHANGES
----------------------------------------------------------------
⚠ THIS BUILD IS MODIFIED, and the modification is ours. `brep_authoring.patch`
is the exact diff. It adds bindings for ON_Brep's own existing construction API
(AddSurface, AddEdgeCurve, AddTrimCurve, NewVertex, NewEdge, NewFace, NewLoop,
NewTrim, the tolerance setters, Compact) to `src/bindings/bnd_brep.{h,cpp}`. No
openNURBS or rhino3dm behavior is changed and nothing is reimplemented — the
capability was already in ON_Brep and was simply not reachable from JavaScript.

The only other local change is the trailing `export default rhino3dm;` that
turns McNeel's UMD output into an ES module.

The patch is a derivative of McNeel's MIT-licensed source and carries the same
terms. It is written to be offerable upstream rather than forked indefinitely.
